verdicts.description: one verdict per claim of the batch, every claim_id of the batch exactly once

verdict.description: confirmed (survived refutation, evidence in hand) | debunked (refuted) | unverified (not settleable from the repo)

reason.description: one line: debunked — what refuted it; unverified — the concrete missing precondition; confirmed — the decisive evidence

evidence.description: path:line, or the command run plus its output

verdict_path.description: absolute path of the batch verdict file written
